questions.question_text: Which of the following statements is false?
questions.question_html: Which of the following statements is false?

B.text: B.Serializability and strict recoverability ensures correctness of a schedule.
B.html: Serializability and strict recoverability ensures correctness of a schedule.

C.text: C.A conflict serializable schedule is always equivalent to one and only one single serial schedule.
C.html: A conflict serializable schedule is always equivalent to one and only one single serial schedule.

D.text: D.All conflict serializable schedules are view serializable, but the reverse need not be true.
D.html: All conflict serializable schedules are view serializable, but the reverse need not be true.

questions.solution_text:
Solution
(c)
For a conflict serializable schedule, the linear ordering of transactions corresponds to topological sorting of the serialization graph. Since there can be multiple such orderings, multiple equivalent serial schedules may exist.
questions.solution_html:
Solution

(c)
